title: smilax higoensis var. ussuriensis
intro: Smilax higoensis var. ussuriensis, commonly known as a type of Smilax vine, is a plant species that belongs to the Smilacaceae family. It has been traditionally used in medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Smilax higoensis var. ussuriensis include treating fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
